_comment: WAEC/WASSCE-level secondary maths & science items for the product-level tutoring eval (bench/eval.py). Each item has an UNAMBIGUOUS canonical final answer chosen so SymPy equivalence can grade it. 'acceptable' lists alternative correct forms (percent/decimal/unit variants, alternate root orderings); a reply matching ANY of them is correct. 'expected_answer' is the plainest canonical form. All answers hand-verified; see the round-trip check in bench/eval.py's --selftest and the item-verification snippet in the build report.

items.subject: math
items.question: Simplify 3/4 + 2/5, leaving your answer as a single fraction in its lowest terms.

items.subject: math
items.question: A trader bought a bag of rice for 18000 naira and sold it for 21600 naira. Calculate the percentage profit.

items.question: A straight ladder leans against a vertical wall, making an angle of 60 degrees with the horizontal ground. If the foot of the ladder is 3 m from the wall, find the length of the ladder. Take cos(60 degrees) = 0.5.
